purpose: Offline source fixtures and executed solver checks. No external solver binary is run; cases marked executed-solver are parsed from the pinned upstream inputs and run through W-Sim solver runners under matched physics, checked against upstream-published output or the case's own analytic values.

cases.name: cavity
cases.limitation: Upstream models this Re=10000 cavity with k-epsilon RAS; the parsed nu/lid/geometry are run on the laminar D2Q9-MRT path as a bounded-regime check only (mass conservation, bounded velocity, recirculation sign). No Ghia agreement is asserted: laminar Re=10000 is outside the validated envelope and turbulent modeling is not simulated.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: openfoam12-cavity Re=10000 RAS case runs bounded on the laminar MRT path

cases.name: planarCouette
cases.limitation: Parsed movingWall/bottomWall/cyclic patches, 20x20x1 mesh and nu are run through the W-Sim D2Q9 Couette channel (new moving-wall bounce-back mode) at the file's wall-node count; checked against the analytic linear Couette profile. The Maxwell viscoelastic model entry is not simulated: the steady shear velocity profile is identical, but normal-stress differences and transients are not validated. A comfortable lattice viscosity is used since the linear steady profile is Re-independent.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: openfoam12-planarcouette moving-wall channel reproduces the linear Couette profile

cases.name: planarPoiseuille
cases.limitation: Laminar half-channel with a constant specific momentum source; parsed nu, momentum source and mesh patch planes are mapped to the D2Q9 force-Poiseuille runner at matched Re_h=250 and checked against the analytic parabolic u_max. The Maxwell viscoelastic model entry, cyclic patches and sigma field are not simulated; finite-volume meshing and OpenFOAM itself are not run.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: openfoam12-planarpoiseuille force-driven channel converges to the analytic profile

cases.name: pitzDailySteady

cases.name: icoFoam laminar lid-driven cavity

cases.name: Three-dimensional LJ melt
cases.limitation: The fail-closed input-script subset interpreter (lammps-input.ts) covers exactly the in.melt command set (units lj, atom_style atomic, lattice fcc, cubic block region, unit mass, lj/cut, fix nve, run); every other command fails closed. The velocity draw honors the `velocity all create` contract (MB at the declared T, zero COM, exact rescale) but the RNG stream is WaveWorld's, not LAMMPS's Park-Miller sequence, so the check asserts energy conservation and physical melting bands — not trajectory agreement. Neighbor/thermo cadences are engine-internal settings. No LAMMPS binary is executed.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: lammps-melt 3D FCC LJ input script executes on the shared MD kernel

cases.name: interFoam two-phase dam break with an obstacle
physics: no-slip walls and an atmospheric opening
cases.limitation: Parsed case physics (two-phase transportProperties, g, laminar, setFieldsDict water column, blockMesh tank bounds, controlDict endTime) drive the WaveWorld 2D WCSPH dam-break solver for a bounded early-collapse window (t=0.25 s of upstream endTime=1 s). Single-phase water only: the air phase and surface tension are not modeled; asserted checks are physical invariants (non-increasing total mechanical energy incl. Tait EOS internal energy, monotone surge front below the Ritter dry-bed bound, falling column top, tank containment, bounded density) — not a VOF/interFoam numerical-equivalence claim. No OpenFOAM binary is executed.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: openfoam8-dambreak WCSPH water column collapses within physical bounds

cases.name: shockFluid one-dimensional perfect-gas shock tube
cases.limitation: Parsed perfect-gas mixture (molWeight/Cp/mu=0), setFieldsDict states and the 1000-cell mesh drive the built-in 1D Euler HLLC solver with transmissive (zeroGradient-equivalent) ends to endTime=0.007 s; checked against an exact Riemann solution. The Kurganov scheme, OpenFOAM runtime, #includeFunc sampling and .orig preprocessing are not run; first-order HLLC contact smearing is asserted, not second-order accuracy.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: openfoam12-shocktube inviscid perfect-gas Riemann problem matches the exact solution

cases.name: B31 cantilever beam, tip force (10-element 3D beam)
cases.limitation: The fail-closed .inp subset interpreter (calculix-inp.ts) covers B31/B31R beam elements with *BEAM SECTION,SECTION=RECT and *BOUNDARY/*CLOAD over dofs 1-6; anything else fails closed. The 3D model is projected onto its in-plane basis and run as beam2d Euler-Bernoulli elements — B31's Timoshenko shear deformation is not modelled (a documented ~0.05% effect for this L/h=40 cantilever; the check bounds it at 1%). Out-of-plane restraints are dropped, nonzero out-of-plane loads/prescribed values fail closed. Unit-free input is adopted as consistent N-mm-MPa and converted to SI. No CCX binary is run; the check compares against the Euler-Bernoulli analytic field and the upstream .frd.ref tip deflection.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: calculix-b31: B31 cantilever beam runs as beam2d and matches Euler-Bernoulli / b31.frd.ref

cases.name: CPS8R uniaxial tension patch (1x1 mm plate)
cases.limitation: The fail-closed .inp subset interpreter (calculix-inp.ts) covers *NODE/*ELEMENT (CPS/CPE 2D types)/*NSET/*ELSET/*BOUNDARY/*MATERIAL/*ELASTIC/*SOLID SECTION/*STEP/*STATIC/*CLOAD/*DLOAD P1-P4 and the output-request keywords; anything else fails closed. Quadratic CPS8R quads run as CST triangles on the corner connectivity — exact for this constant-strain patch; mid-side nodes and their boundary rows are reduced away. Unit-free input is adopted as consistent N-mm-MPa and converted to SI. No CCX binary is run; the check compares against the upstream .dat.ref.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: calculix-planestress CPS8R tension patch runs as CST and matches planestress.dat.ref

cases.name: CPE4 uniaxial tension quad (plane strain)
cases.limitation: Same fail-closed .inp subset as calculix-planestress. The single CPE4 quad runs as two CST triangles under plane-strain — exact for the constant-strain field (syy=100 MPa, szz=nu*syy=30 MPa). Unit-free input adopted as N-mm-MPa and converted to SI; no CCX binary is run.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: calculix-planestrain CPE4 tension quad runs as CST and matches planestrain.dat.ref

cases.name: CPE8 quadratic nodal-load tension quad (plane strain)
cases.limitation: Same fail-closed .inp subset as calculix-planestress, plus CPE8. The CLOADs are the quadratic consistent distribution for uniform syy=100 MPa (0.1667 on each top corner, 0.6667 on the top mid-side node); the CST reduction folds the mid-side load 50/50 onto the edge endpoints, which reproduces the same uniform traction exactly for this affine field. Unit-free input adopted as N-mm-MPa and converted to SI; no CCX binary is run.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: calculix-planestrain2 CPE8 tension quad folds mid-side CLOADs and matches planestrain2.dat.ref

cases.name: simple_diffusion (2D Dirichlet diffusion)
cases.limitation: The fail-closed hit-syntax interpreter (moose-inp.ts) covers GeneratedMesh 2D, one FIRST-order LAGRANGE variable, one Diffusion kernel (coefficient 1), DirichletBC/NeumannBC on the named side sets, Steady executioner; any other block/parameter fails closed. MOOSE solves the same PDE with Q1 finite elements; WaveWorld runs node-centred FD on the same mesh — the exact solution u=x is linear so the method difference drops out. No MOOSE binary is run; the check is against the analytic field.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: moose-simple-diffusion 2D Dirichlet diffusion matches u=x to solver tolerance

cases.name: simple_transient_diffusion (CoefDiffusion + TimeDerivative)
cases.limitation: Same hit-syntax subset as moose-simple-diffusion plus CoefDiffusion/TimeDerivative kernels and the Transient executioner. The 2-D problem is y-invariant, so the built-in 1-D Crank-Nicolson solver is used at MOOSE's dt=0.1, 20 steps. Compared against the Fourier-series exact solution of the fixed-end slab — integrator-agnostic, so MOOSE's backward-Euler scheme difference drops out. No MOOSE binary is run.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: moose-simple-transient-diffusion CN slab transient matches the analytic Fourier series at t=2

cases.name: NAFEMS T3 transient heat conduction benchmark
cases.limitation: Same hit-syntax subset plus FunctionDirichletBC (a strict parsed-expression evaluator), HeatConduction/HeatConductionTimeDerivative kernels and GenericConstantMaterial (k, cp, rho). The problem is y-invariant; it runs on the built-in 1-D Crank-Nicolson solver with time-varying Dirichlet support at MOOSE's dt=1 s, refined to 200 FD cells. Verified against the closed-form exact solution (steady-oscillation sinh part plus the decaying sine series, NAFEMS answer T(0.08,32)=36.6) and the bundled MOOSE quad4 fine gold CSV — the gold's own ~0.42 K early-time deviation is bounded, not asserted away. MOOSE solves with QUAD4 Q1 FE + backward Euler; our FD+CN is a different discretization, so the check is against the analytic benchmark, not equivalence. No MOOSE binary is run.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: moose-nafems-t3 CN slab matches the analytic series to ~0.02 K and the bundled gold CSV to ~0.41 K

cases.name: CASL verification I.1 — 1D slab with volumetric heat source
cases.limitation: The fail-closed hit-syntax interpreter covers the dim=1 EDGE2 GeneratedMesh, HeatConduction + constant HeatSource kernels, DirichletBC, Steady, GenericConstantMaterial and [Functions] ParsedFunction (symbol_names/symbol_values via a whitelist AST evaluator — no eval); anything else fails closed. The nodal FD solution is exact for this quadratic field; the upstream error metric (elementwise |u_h-u*| dx over the piecewise-linear interpolant) is reproduced at each h of the bundled convergence CSV. No MOOSE binary is run.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: moose-casl-i1: heat-source slab matches the bundled ParsedFunction and L1 gold series

cases.name: ConvectiveHeatFluxBC hand-calc case (Robin BC, surface T=150, flux -500)
cases.limitation: The interpreter maps ConvectiveHeatFluxBC (T_infinity + heat_transfer_coefficient, dT=0) to a Robin BC and the HeatConduction kernel's literal thermal_conductivity parameter to conductivity; the Transient num_steps=1 executioner has no TimeDerivative kernel, so MOOSE semantics make it a stationary solve run on the steady solver. Surface T=150 (hand calc) and the -500 W/m^2 diffusive flux are checked against the bundled flux_out.csv gold. No MOOSE binary is run.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: moose-convective-flux: ConvectiveHeatFluxBC reproduces the hand-calc surface T and -500 flux

cases.name: CASL verification I.4 — heated plate with flux + convective (enclosure-cooling archetype)
cases.limitation: CASL problem I.4 (SAND2020-3887): k=1 plate, q=1200 source, NeumannBC 200 inflow left, CoupledConvectiveHeatFluxBC htc=10/T_infinity=100 right. This is the canonical electronics/enclosure-cooling abstraction (dissipating wall + airflow film) reduced to 1-D verification form — full conjugate CFD (Icepak/FloTHERM-style) is NOT simulated. The interpreter maps the literal-htc coupled BC to Robin and the Neumann value to inward heat flux; run on the 1-D steady solver across the upstream h-sequence, checked nodally against the bundled ParsedFunction exact solution (u(0)=1040, u(1)=240) and the energy balance (200+1200 = h(u_R−100)). No MOOSE binary is run.
cases.test: src/lib/sim/software-cases-exec.test.ts: moose-casl-i4: heated plate with flux + convection matches the enclosure-cooling archetype
